# dr5dymrsxhdzh.cloudfront.net

> A comprehensive mortgage and home financing resource offering calculators, rate comparisons, lender reviews, and guidance for homebuyers and property investors.

This site provides SmartAsset's mortgage tools and educational content covering everything from rate shopping and affordability assessment to closing costs estimation and specialized programs like VA loans. It aggregates current mortgage rates from major lenders and offers detailed comparisons across loan types including fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages.

## Key Topics

- Mortgage Calculator
- Mortgage Rates
- 30-Year Fixed
- 15-Year Fixed
- 5/1 ARM
- 7/1 ARM
- Home Affordability
- Closing Costs
- Mortgage Lenders
- VA Loans
- Rocket Mortgage
- Refinancing
- Jumbo Loans
- Cost of Living
- Financial Planning

## Mortgage Calculators & Planning Tools

- [Mortgage Calculator: Interest, PMI and Taxes](https://dr5dymrsxhdzh.cloudfront.net/mortgage/mortgage-calculator): SmartAsset's mortgage calculator for monthly payments, PMI, taxes and costs
- [Home Affordability Calculator - How Much House Can I Afford?](https://dr5dymrsxhdzh.cloudfront.net/mortgage/how-much-house-can-i-afford): Home affordability calculator to determine realistic home purchase budget
- [Closing Costs Calculator - How Much Are Closing Costs for Buyers?](https://dr5dymrsxhdzh.cloudfront.net/mortgage/closing-costs): Calculator for closing costs estimation using local tax and fee data
- [2026 Cost of Living Calculator - Compare by City & State](https://dr5dymrsxhdzh.cloudfront.net/mortgage/cost-of-living-calculator): Compare cost of living across cities and states for relocation planning
